none: PAS CAM-B6CF29: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy barbarous radiate copying Divus Claudius, c. AD 275-285
contea di ritrovamento: City of Peterborough (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy barbarous radiate copying Divus Claudius, c. AD 275-285 (Reece period 14). Reverse legend reads [...]TIO. Reverse shows Eagle standing left, head right. Obverse legend is illegible. Obverse shows a radiate head right. Die axis is 11 o'clock. Weight is 2.14g, diameter is 14.8mm, thickness is 2.0mm
